Results.ReviewText:
It’s Thanksgiving and for the past 18 yrs I have grilled my turkey’s on my original 22. Sadly this August, had to retire it due the bottom rusting out. 

This year would be no different, soo I went out the Tues before and picked up a new one from The Home Depot. 

Right out of the box as I put it together, I realized what I was not putting together an upgrade to what I previously owned, but rather an inferior knockoff! 

WEBER… WHAT HAPPENED TO YOU???

The heavier grates, the thermometer, the wheel covers… nice, but they seem to be distractors to the fact that kettle itself is clearly made from a much thinner gauge steel than my original 22. 
 
In all the years I owned my original, the handle never got so hot that I needed a heat shield. I can only imagine it’s due to the thinner gauge steel. 

Another ting about the lid… it just sits on top of the drum, and with no weight… there is no seal as you can see by my photos. The lid to my original hugged the lip of the drum creating a seal. 

One positive… the thermometer works well. It confirmed that the drum holds less heat resulting more coal to retain a consistent temperature.

Lastly… I ask you again…,”Weber, what happened to you?”
Results.Title: What happened to you?

Results.ReviewText: We have had our the Master-Touch 22 for about a month now and are very pleased with it.  It’s not our first Weber (had traditional, gas and small ones) but we haven’t grilled for a couple of years (long story...) and needed a new one.  The bi-level grills are great for cooking vegetables while searing meat, or keeping things off the direct heat and cooking multiple kinds of food at the same time.  The temperture gage is key in doing this.  Also, the indirect charcoal bins are wonderful for things like cedar plank fish, or beer can chicken.  Have done both and they were great!  Being able to tilt the lid back and store it is a very nice feature and handy for managing the wind a bit.  Looking forward to year-round grilling.  Overall, a great grill!

Results.ReviewText: Purchased 1 month ago, used 4 times. Easy to clean and if you practice a little, use right technique, ash can is easy to remove and put back on - friend bought same grill on same day as I did and agrees. Many say this is hard and if you don’t follow this it is. Great proven design. Love how well it works and the many YouTube vids that teach you all you need to know. Buy one! Worth every penny! Results.ReviewText: I bought this on Memorial day for a family BBQ. I was so excited to find that the store only had 1 left and it was mine. Had a problem with a bent handle on the actual bowl piece...Weber had some othe best customer service I have experienced in a long time and had a whole new bowl out to me within just a few days. From an amazing flavor to an overall amazing product to which seems is ran by an amazing company is why I give this BBQ 5 stars.

Results.ReviewText: Have had Weber grills for decades. My last one lasted 15 years and was out in the weather summer and winter. Really like the grate feature to be able to add coals, the temp. gauge and ash remover. Did have any of that on my other ones. Have had a few steaks and burgers everything came out great. Probably keep this one covered when not in use.

Don’t let anybody tell you you can’t smoke ribs on a weber cattle these were as good as any I’ve ever made

Results.ReviewText:
This is my second Kettle, the original was the victim of a hurricane. This Master touch is much better with the modifications and options it’s become a excellent tool to produce some amazing Q.  I added a second thermometer next to the dome vent. I have learned the the vent should be over a he food. That’s where I put the second gage.  I’ve noticed that the temperature is about 20°
difference can be critical. I also opted for the Gormet BBQ system.  Accessories, the center sear grate pt# 8834 and pt# 8835
I also purchased the “Vortex” cone and a “Slow and Sear indirect. I highly Recommend. The ash catcher is a great idea. I like the way it works. If I had complaint, I would create a longer throw so the bottom vent completely sweep the vent. And put a curve to more effective sweeps. Overall I love it. 
A Classic
Results.Title: Master Touch - I modified mine

Results.ReviewText:
I bought my Webber kettle about two months ago, after reading about them and watching others use them. I can honestly say, that I am not in the least bit disappointed. I have used it for grilling and smoking meats. It just took one time using it, to figure out the vent system. After that, it was fairly easy to keep a consistent temperature. The only item I swapped out, was the cooking grate. I wasn't to crazy about the removable center on the cooking grate and it bothered me a bit. For only $20.00, that took care of any concerns I had. I bought mine at a bit box store, non assembled. When I got it home and started to assemble it, it was missing the assembly instructions. No problem, I watched a few YouTube videos and it went very well. The kettle itself, didn't have the holes pre drilled for the lid holder. I called customer service and they had one sent out and I received it within a week. I bought it for a memorial day cook out and decided to drill the holes myself. It was very easy to do and it works great. I have an extra kettle if I ever need to replace the bottom in the future. I could have probably took it back to the store and replaced it, but the wheels were in motion and I took care of it myself. It's my first kettle grill and I actually am very pleased with it. I plan on building a counter top for it and setting it down in it, as counter space is a must at the grill.
I would recommend this kettle grill to anyone wanting a new grill, you just can't go wrong with a Webber.
Results.Title: A great grill/smoker

Results.ReviewText: I originally had the basic 22" Weber kettle grill for over 10 years until my wife sold or gave it away because "it was getting kinda old"! It still worked great! So I knew I would like the Master-Touch, but didn't know how much! It is wonderful! All of the extra features are great! It is so easy to clean out and controllable, you can fine-tune the temperature to wherever you want and when you're done grilling, you can shut it down and put the fire out very quickly, which saves any charcoal leftover that you can use on your next fire! I've used it several times now, since I bought it about a month ago and really enjoy grilling on it. You will not regret buying this Grill!
Results.Title: Great charcoal grill!

Results.ReviewText:
This is your typical high quality Weber Kettle BBQ. It was a snap to assemble and all parts fit perfect, except one wheel cover that had two broken studs. I have contacted customer service and have no doubt they'll come through with a replacement.

This grill is great to cook on. My 18" Weber Kettle was a bit to small for my family of 4 as we tend to cook different meats and veggies when we bbq. The "22 kettle is the perfect size and I can throw on a variety of meats and veggie with room to spare as well as heat corn or bread on the included rack that comes with the Master-Touch.
Results.Title: No one makes kettle charcoal grills like weber

Results.ReviewText: There's nothing like the taste of a medium rare ribeye coming off this Weber!
Results.Title: Unmistakeable flavor

Results.ReviewText: Great Weber quality and durability.  This is one of many Weber Kettles i’ve Owned and they have really stepped up their game with options for indirect grilling.  The thermometer really helps out.  The grates are great quality and heavy gauge,
Results.Title: Great quality and durability.

Results.ReviewText: Great little kettle grill. Easy to use. Even heat distribution. Temperature control is a snap. Accessories are available to allow you to cook all different kinds of food. The finish is durable and lasts even in the harshest of environments. If something should go wrong, Weber has been around forever and replacement parts are easy to find.
Results.Title: Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: Don't hesitate to buy this grill, forget about all the hype about the over priced green eggs and their knock off's, this grill makes the best food I have ever had on a grill. I have used several grills, gas grills, char grill, for many years and this one is hands down the best. Bigger and more expensive doesn't mean it's better! We are a family of 9 and this grill was priced right and is plenty big enough for us and guests. Close off the vents when you're done grilling and you can save your charcoal for the next time! This grill makes the juiciest hamburgers I have ever had, Salmon on this grill is better than any restaurant.  I am telling you, if you want the best flavor buy this grill.
Results.Title: Best grill ever!

First, there were a few wrong nuts in the box, so required a trip to the hardware store.  Second, the lid does not seal to the body well and it leaks air like a sieve.  This makes it impossible to maintain cooking temperatures.  Honestly, if I had known about this issue, I would not have purchased the grill.

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
